changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file".cdn_data ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4() NOT NULL, user_id UUID, content_length BIGINT, ext TEXT, folder TEXT, content_url TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS file_idx_cdn_data_user ON "file".cdn_data (user_id);
